answer: A 50 POA deposit buys entry as one vertex in a public referral graph, every sponsorship edge on-chain. Like a cedar, real identity grows slowly: deposits unlock only after 20 clean epochs. A beacon audits one vertex each epoch; a star cluster of clones in its subtree triggers a dispute slashing the deposit and the referrer's too. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA, burned on capture; an honest agent pays once and keeps an undiluted share.
